milestones.title: Put and Get
milestones.when: shell: `bao kv get` of your own `.../db` secret (exit 0), which comes after the put

milestones.title: Version Hoarder
milestones.joke: Versions kept so you can undo.
milestones.when: shell: `bao kv get -version=N` or `bao kv metadata get` (exit 0)

milestones.title: Deleted, Undeleted, Destroyed
milestones.when: shell: `bao kv destroy` (exit 0), the last of delete, undelete and destroy

milestones.title: Knocked on a Neighbour's Door
milestones.when: shell: `bao kv get` or `list` of another student's `secret/students/<name>/` path fails
